paper_title: A Universal Fluorinated Polymer Acceptor Enables All-Polymer Solar Cells with >15% Efficiency

knowledge_points.content: PFA1 is an n-type copolymer designed using a fluorinated 1,1-dicyanomethylene-3-indanone unit (end group) and a thiophene spacer unit, synthesized via Stille polycondensation.
knowledge_points.evidence: In this study, we designed a novel n-type copolymer, PFA1, based on the fluorinated 1,1-dicyanomethylene-3-indanone unit and a thiophene spacer unit (Scheme 1)... Finally, a Stille polycondensation of Y5-F-Br and 2,5-bis(trimethylstannyl)thiophene afforded copolymer PFA1.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized all-polymer solar cell based on the PTzBI-oF:PFA1 blend achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 15.11%, with a Voc of 0.87 V, Jsc of 23.96 mA cm^-2, and FF of 72.67%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimized all-PSCs exhibit a remarkably high efficiency of 15.11%... In contrast, the device based on PFA1 presented a dramatically enhanced PCE of 13.23% which was further improved to 15.11% (Voc = 0.87 V, Jsc = 23.96 mA cm^-2 and FF = 72.67%) upon processing with 1-chloronaphthalene.

knowledge_points.content: Fluorination of the acceptor framework in PFA1 lowers the energy levels (HOMO: -5.74 eV; LUMO: -3.84 eV) and red-shifts the absorption profile compared to the non-fluorinated counterpart PY5T.
knowledge_points.evidence: The PFA1 film exhibits a peak absorption at 815 nm which is red-shifted relative to the 792 nm peak absorption of its nonfluorinated counterpart, PY5T... The highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) and the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) energy levels of PFA1 were estimated to be -5.74 and -3.84 eV; respectively, both of which are slightly lower than those of PY5T [-5.71 and -3.76 eV].

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of fluorine atoms in PFA1 creates a noncovalent S...F interaction that enhances intrachain co-planarity and rigidity, leading to higher oscillator strength and charge transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: IC-F-T exhibited a torsional potential barrier slightly higher than that of IC-H-T, which may be attributable to the existence of a noncovalent bonding interaction between the F atom and the S atom in the thiophene unit. Such strong intrachain co-planarity and rigidity enhance the polymer oscillator strength and charge transport.

knowledge_points.content: PFA1 exhibits a high extinction coefficient of 9.4 x 10^4 cm^-1 and an optical bandgap of 1.41 eV, which are superior to those of the non-fluorinated PY5T.
knowledge_points.evidence: The PFA1 film exhibits an extinction coefficient of 9.4 x 10^4 cm^-1, which is slightly higher than that of PY5T (8.1 x 10^4 cm^-1)... The optical bandgap of PFA1 was estimated to be 1.41 eV from the onset of the absorption profile.

knowledge_points.content: PFA1 demonstrates universality as an acceptor, achieving PCEs of 11.94% with PTzBI-Si, 13.75% with PM6, and 14.20% with PBDB-T donors.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is interesting to note that these devices showed impressively high PCEs of 11.94% 13.75% and 14.20% for PTzBI-Si-based cells, PM6-based cells, and PBDB-T-based cells, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The PTzBI-oF/PFA1 blend exhibits a lower Flory-Huggins interaction parameter (χ_D-A = 1.65 x 10^-4 K) compared to the PY5T blend (1.38 x 10^-1 K), indicating significantly improved donor-acceptor miscibility.
knowledge_points.evidence: The PTzBI-oF/PFA1 blend had a χ_D-A (1.65 x 10^-4 K) that was lower than that of the PTzBI-oF/PY5T blend film (1.38 x 10^-1 K), indicating the greater miscibility of PTzBI-oF and PFA1.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis shows that PFA1 films possess a 'face-on' orientation with a crystalline coherence length (CCL) of 82 Å in the PTzBI-oF/PFA1 blend, which is higher than the 65 Å observed for the PY5T blend.
knowledge_points.evidence: Both blend films showed similar face-on textures... whereas the PTzBI-oF/PFA1 blend showed a sharper lamellar stacking peak in the in-plane direction, resulting in a crystalline coherence length of 82 Å, which was greater than the value of 65 Å for the PTzBI-oF/PY5T blend film.

knowledge_points.content: PFA1-based devices exhibit significantly higher charge carrier mobilities, with a hole mobility of 1.03 x 10^-3 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 and an electron mobility of 5.49 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1.
knowledge_points.evidence: The device based on PFA1 presented... h (cm^2 V^-1 s^-1) 1.03 x 10^-3 and e (cm^2 V^-1 s^-1) 5.49 x 10^-4 (Table 1).

knowledge_points.content: The exciton dissociation efficiency P(E,T) in PFA1-based devices is 95.6%, which is substantially higher than the 63.0% observed in PY5T-based devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: Under the short-circuit conditions, the exciton dissociation efficiencies P(E,T) were calculated to be 63.0% and 95.6% for the PY5T- and PFA1- based devices, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Large-area PFA1-based all-PSCs with an active area of 1 cm^2 maintained a high PCE of 14.03%.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is also worth pointing out that the device based on PFA1 with an active area of 1 cm^2 also exhibited a prominent PCE of 14.03% (Voc = 0.89 V, Jsc = 23.99 mA cm^-2, and FF = 65.79%).

knowledge_points.content: PFA1-based devices show reduced trap-assisted monomolecular and bimolecular recombination, as evidenced by a Voc vs. light intensity slope of 1.35 kT/q and a high Jsc vs. light intensity slope.
knowledge_points.evidence: The Voc - Plight plots indicate that the dependence of Voc on Plight for the PFA1-based device was 1.35 kT/q... demonstrated that the weaker trap-assisted monomolecular recombination and the second-order bimolecular recombination are weaker in the PFA1 cell.
